Reentrancy in PENNY_BY_PENNY.Collect(uint256) (../sb/0x96edbe868531bd23a6c05e9d0c424ea64fb1b78b.sol#55-69):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (../sb/0x96edbe868531bd23a6c05e9d0c424ea64fb1b78b.sol#63)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- acc.balance -= _am (../sb/0x96edbe868531bd23a6c05e9d0c424ea64fb1b78b.sol#65)
	PENNY_BY_PENNY.Acc (../sb/0x96edbe868531bd23a6c05e9d0c424ea64fb1b78b.sol#17) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- PENNY_BY_PENNY.Acc (../sb/0x96edbe868531bd23a6c05e9d0c424ea64fb1b78b.sol#17)
	- PENNY_BY_PENNY.Collect(uint256) (../sb/0x96edbe868531bd23a6c05e9d0c424ea64fb1b78b.sol#55-69)
	- PENNY_BY_PENNY.Put(uint256) (../sb/0x96edbe868531bd23a6c05e9d0c424ea64fb1b78b.sol#45-53)
findings.name: reentrancy-eth
